data.one_liner: Flutter widget to dismiss or trigger actions with animated background and corners.
data.what_it_does: A fork of Dismissible that allows animated rounded corners, elevation changes, background animations during swiping, and swipe-to-trigger actions without dismissing the tile.
use_when: You need swipe-to-dismiss behavior with custom animated backgrounds and rounded corners similar to modern mobile apps.
You need a swipe-to-trigger action without actually dismissing the tile.
avoid_when: You need vertical, up and down swiping.
You need a standard simple Dismissible widget without custom background animation requirements.
strengths: Supports animated backgrounds and progress tracking via backgroundBuilder.
Provides card constructors with constant rounded corners and custom shadows.
Supports swipe-to-trigger actions instead of only dismissal.
weaknesses: Does not support vertical, up and down swipe directions.
Cannot call setState directly from backgroundBuilder.
